resources.basis: Native full sixteen-run batch completed. New independent reader verifies all 1,046,000 branch-marker cells, 8,368 branch summaries, all native NEXUS cell/aggregate annotations and format-specific precision. Three synthetic native contracts include fractional percentages/long branch precision and zero denominators; all 26 altered exports rejected. Preserve original failed reader/closure journals and original native outputs. Two CPU/16 GiB/no swap/one BLAS thread per serial reader/closure, 2 GiB output allowance, 100 GiB reserve, uncalibrated .01-4h stage planning interval, no GPU/new charges/restarts.

scope: All 250 audited profile/MAFFT marker trees against all eight closed original 526-taxon PMSF ML/consensus reference views: sixteen native gCF runs and all 1,046,000 branch-marker cells. Reference internal labels removed before native rerooting; original support joined by canonical split. Independent reconstruction verifies every native statistic and per-gene state, preserving nondecisive missing-clade cases as unavailable and handling native all-NA zero-denominator outputs explicitly. Canonical NNI alternatives retain a consistent per-branch mapping to native NNI labels. Full source hashes and two original producer/reader completion journals are required for closure. Concordance is conditional on inferred marker topologies and candidate species references; gene estimation uncertainty, orthology/model adequacy, root, taxon/marker sensitivities, biological causes of discordance, dating and accepted evolutionary effects remain unresolved. No GPU, paid infrastructure or restart of existing analyses; all eight scientific aims remain incomplete.
